reviews.comment: She is nice but the way she teaches a language is really bad. She teaches straight from the textbook instead of different ways.

Professor Larson is very nice. She teaches straight from the textbook which can be a bit challenging at times, but overall will answer any questions you have. The homework also helps a lot when it comes to learning new concepts. She does an exam review before the exam which is pretty much the same as the exam so its very helpful!

A fine French speaker, but a terrible teacher. She smiles very prettily when students are doing well in her class, but if they are, it is not because of her! You must learn everything from the textbook, with only review and conversation in class. And by conversation, I mean with your peers, not even her.

If you ask for help, she will brush you off
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Mme. Larson is a great teacher! This year was her first teaching 101, she did great. Most of her lessons are through the textbook so I would recommend getting the textbook and being up to date on the online homework. Small classes but fun!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, this prof was the most unprofessional professor I've ever had. I came to her office hours to discuss a paper but she turned me away because she was "busy" during her own office hours?? She offers extra credit but at the last minute, she takes it back because she blames it on poor class attendance. She is also very degrading. avoid her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wonderful teacher and very kind, she is intelligent and passionate, she let me even come to her office hours to discuss the books we read in class, one of my favourite professors, make sure you go to her office hours, she never denies to help so its illogical to complain about the difficulty of the course if youre lazy to seek help

Prof. Larson was a great professor. Already having a knowledge of French, maybe I was more inclined to her teaching style, as it was centered around students reading outside of class, then discussing things in class. Because it was over Zoom, she really cared about people having their cameras on and being focused on the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I'm having to take this professor for the 2nd time because she's the only option. This is the worst french teacher I've ever had, and I've been enrolled in French courses for seven years now. Class is homework heavy, literally over 200 assignments not including quizzes, readings, and presentations. Do HW or you will fail even if you know french.

Larson clearly knew French well but she does not know how to lead a class... our classes were a waste of time and her tests are stupidly difficult and REALLY long. She was unnecessarily rude to her students and has way too much homework and outside assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance isnt mandatory but if you skip even once you wont pass. Her grading is subjective and all of the students agree, regardless of grade received in class. Class is just groupwork answering one question from a reading guide. She does not lecture or teach at all in class. Though its a diversity class, most books are by old french guys.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: PLEASE TAKE ANOTHER PROFESSOR. The french department needs better professors who teach better, and who truly want to help the students, this prof was not that. Take JB if he is teaching this he's the absolute best professor.

Waste of time sitting in class, you learn absolutely nothing. She really misleads students about attendance, and then when people fail her exams she tries to offer a redo but for only ppl with less than a certain number of absences which really helps no one because attendance is stated as optional. She's really passive aggressiv to those who skip.

She is tough and gets distracted during her lectures. Tough grader, almost unnecessarily. Attendance isn't mandatory but she is passive aggressive to those who decide to skip. Although, she is nice if you come see her during office hours but still a tough class. Would not take unless it's required, and if it is: look for a different prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If French comes easy to you, you will be absolutely fine in her class. Otherwise, it can be tough. Attendance was optional so I skipped a lot and still did fine. She tends to trail off topic in her lectures. Take another prof if you can.

Prof. Larson was a great professor. While you probably don't have much professor choice, she is very caring and approachable. She formatted the class well and the final grade was a healthy mix of tests, projects, homework, etc. You do still have to put in work for the class (concentrate especially on the grammar), but an A is very doable!

There are only 2 papers (4 pages and 10 pages) and a midterm. Read the books and participate in class. Make sure to take good notes and come to class prepared but be ready to do all the paper and test prep on your own. If your writing does not agree with her analysis of poem or book, you will receive a low grade. Do not take unless required.

Her class was hard because she did not give us instructions for how to write the papers or prepare for the midterm. The class is only 3 grades, 2 papers and a midterm and she made it impossible to prepare for either. In lectures, she rambled, got off topic, and was very rude to anyone who did not have the same opinion as her. Hostile environment.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Her class was the worst class I have ever been in. Her lectures were boring and unbearable, her books that we had to read were strange and offensive. She says attendance is not mandatory but expects you to be in class everyday. She glares at you when using the restroom and doesn't explain the instructions for the papers. Horrible. Never take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There are only 4 quizzes and 1 final and they are based off the books required for the class. If you don't read, you will not pass!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good class, her tests are somewhat specific but if you go to class and do the reading guides (and the readings) then you won't have many problems. There are only 4 tests and a final with no homework, except to read the books.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria
